mapper.select: SELECT `id`, `inviter_guid`, `assistant_guid`, `book_id`, `point_count`, `assistant_type` FROM assist_record WHERE `inviter_guid` = #{inviterGuid} AND `received` = 0 AND `expired_timestamp` > #{currentTimeMillis}

SELECT sum(`point_count`) as total_unreceived_points, count(*) as total_unreceived_assists FROM assist_record WHERE `inviter_guid` = #{inviterGuid} AND `received` = 0 AND `expired_timestamp` > #{currentTimeMillis}

SELECT id, inviter_guid, assistant_guid, book_id, date_mark, point_count, assist_timestamp, receive_time, expired_timestamp, assistant_type, received FROM assist_record WHERE inviter_guid = #{inviterGuid} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT id, inviter_guid, assistant_guid, date_mark, point_count, assist_timestamp, receive_time, expired_timestamp, assistant_type, received FROM assist_record WHERE inviter_guid = #{inviterGuid} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
